stem: Which quotation provides the best evidence of the narrator’s sensitivity?

options.label: F
options.text: She and I would walk through them, counting the blooms.

options.label: G
options.text: It sent a shiver through me.

options.label: H
options.text: I snuck it into the rosebushes in the yard, tying it to a branch.

options.label: J
options.text: Bonnie and I were wandering around the store, unable to make up our minds what to choose.
